Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harming integrity of your working device, ABC & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, as changing system settings, installing system-level software or steal confidential information, like passwords.

Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

- ABC Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base ABC Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the ABC Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from ABC Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of ABC Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between ABC Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a ABC Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base ABC Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by the ABC/IT Infrastructure Department with the exception of trial software that should only be used for evaluation purposes

- You are also responsible for providing a patch management

✔️ Only personnel from GFB Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GFB Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GFB Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GFB Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base GFB Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by the GFB/IT Infrastructure Department with the exception of trial software that should only be used for evaluation purposes

Subject: Request for Administrative Rights

Dear Martina,

Thank you for your request regarding administrative rights for your upcoming project and Udemy courses.

To proceed with your request, please complete the following steps:

1. **Justification**: Provide a detailed justification for the need for administrative rights, including the specific software you plan to install.

Please note that granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk to your device and the company’s infrastructure. Such rights should only be requested if necessary for regular tasks. Once you provide the required information, we can proceed with your request.

Thank you for your cooperation.

Best regards,

[Your Position]  
[Your Contact Information]

✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base GHF Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by the GHF/IT Infrastructure Department with the exception of trial software that should only be used for evaluation purposes

reference_reply:

- Need: Extra information needed to request admin rights on the computer
- Do you need admin rights for one-time action / software installation?: No I need those rights every week for running and installing software.
- Do you need temporary short or long term admin rights?: Long Term: Choose this if you need to regularly execute administrative tasks (justification required)
- General Instructions:
Please provide the full name of your GHT employee manager (L6 or above). If they are unavailable, please provide an alternative contact to complete this request.

NOTE: If you are L6 and above, you don't need a manager approval. Therefore please add your own name as the approver.

The field below only accepts persons with Level L6 and above
- Project Manager Full name: Leonardo di Marco (Verona) (B23C)
- Computer name information:
Below you will find the computers Group IT has already assigned to you, the available names may not match the one on the label of your PC.

To identify your computer name pls check the Device Name in the company portal application or open a cmd command window and write hostname.

If your PC is not in the list, please ensure to select Not in the list (PC) and place the name of your computer in the Other Computer Name field, in that case, ensure to fill that field.
- Computer Name: GHT-x9HsRm3opLQ (PC)
- Other Computer name:
- Computer System: Windows
- Additional information:
Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harming integrity of your working device, GHT & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, as changing system settings, installing system-level software or steal confidential information, like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested, if you need it for regular repeating tasks for daily business (please provide reason in ticket request, it will not approved without proper justification).
Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Some clients requirements demands us to not work with local admin rights, it is highly important that you check prior with your manager that you do not violate client contract by your request.
- List clients and projects you work on.:
BPQR
- Justification, including the list of software/actions that requires you to have admin Rights:
Java JDK
IDE
DB Clients
Customer VPN
- Important Information:
The provided local admin rights will require to be renewed after 12 Months after the approval. A new request will be required at that time if those rights are still needed.
- GHT Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base GHT Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the GHT Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from GHT Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GHT Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GHT Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GHT Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base GHT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by the GHT/IT Infrastructure Department with the exception of trial software that should only be used for evaluation purposes

- You are also responsible for providing a patch management process for the software that you additionally installed (with special attention to security patches)

baseline.answer:
Subject: Request for Administrator Rights

Hello,

Thank you for your request regarding administrator rights on your computer. To proceed, please provide the following information:

1. **Do you need admin rights for a one-time action/software installation or for ongoing tasks?** 
   - If it's for a one-time installation, please use the Service and Subcategory "Windows Software Installation - I need software or a license installed on my computer."

2. **Do you need temporary short-term or long-term admin rights?**
   - If you require long-term rights, please provide justification for the ongoing need.

3. **Manager Approval:**
   - Please provide the full name of your manager (L6 or above). If you are L6 or above, you can approve your own request.

4. **Computer Name:**
   - To identify your computer name, check the Device Name in the company portal application or open a command prompt and type `hostname`. If your PC is not listed, please specify the name in the "Other Computer Name" field.

5. **Justification:**
   - Include a list of software or actions that require admin rights.

Please note that granting permanent local admin rights increases security risks, and such requests should be justified accordingly. 

Once you provide the necessary information, we can proceed with your request.

Best regards,  
[Your Name]  
IT Support Team

feedback.answer:

Best regards,  
[Your Name]  
IT Support Team

Please provide the full name of your XYO employee manager (L6 or above). If they are unavailable, please provide an alternative contact to complete this request.

- Computer Name: XYO-DFG53RdJzYH (PC)

- Additional information:
Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harming integrity of your working device, XYO & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, such as changing system settings, installing system-level software, or stealing confidential information like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested if you need it for regular repeating tasks for daily business (please provide reason in ticket request, it will not be approved without proper justification).
Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Hi,

with the latest version of Java, the_home variable doesn't point to the correct java installation.

I also need to change MAVEN_HOME quite frequently to work on several projects that require different versions of Maven.

Can I please have permanent admin rights on my PC to avoid opening a ticket every time?

Thank you!
- Important Information:
The provided local admin rights will require to be renewed after 12 months after the approval. A new request will be required at that time if those rights are still needed.
- XYO Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base XYO Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the XYO Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from XYO Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of XYO Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between XYO Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a XYO Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party

Subject: Request for Administrator Rights

Dear [User's Name],

Thank you for your request regarding administrator rights to change path variables on your PC. To proceed with your request, please provide the following information:

1. **Manager Approval**: Please provide the full name of your manager (L6 or above). If they are unavailable, an alternative contact can be provided for approval. If you are L6 or above, you may add your own name as the approver.

2. **Computer Name**: To identify your computer, please check the Device Name in the company portal application or open a command prompt and type `hostname`. If your PC is not listed, select "Not in the list (PC)" and provide the name of your computer in the "Other Computer Name" field.

3. **Justification**: Please include a detailed justification for needing permanent admin rights, specifying the software/actions that require these rights.

4. **Client Compliance**: Ensure that your request does not violate any client contracts. Please list the clients and projects you are currently working on.

Please note that granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk to your device and the company infrastructure. Such rights should only be requested if necessary for regular tasks. 

Once you provide the required information, we can proceed with your request.

Best regards,

[Your Name]

Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harming integrity of your working device, GFT & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, as changing system settings, installing system-level software or steal confidential information, like passwords.

Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Ivanti VPN

more

Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base GFT Group system installations.

✔️ Only personnel from GFT Group may request LAR privileges.

✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GFT Group is eligible and may be installed.

✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GFT Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.

✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base GFT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)

retrieval.title: I need administrator rights on my computer
retrieval.reply:
Below you will find the additional form information for that request and the information you filled out.

- Need: Extra information needed to request admin rights on the computer
- Do you need admin rights for one-time action / software installation?: No I need those rights every week for running and installing software.
- Do you need temporary short or long term admin rights?: Long Term: Choose this if you need to regularly execute administrative tasks (justification required)
- General Instructions:
Please provide the full name of your GFT employee manager (L6 or above). If they are unavailable, please provide an alternative contact to complete this request.

NOTE: If you are L6 and above, you don't need a manager approval. Therefore please add your own name as the approver.

The field below only accept persons with Level L6 and above
- Project Manager Full name: Giovanni Bertucci (Catania) (X92D)
- Computer name information:
Below you will find the computers Group IT has already assigned to you, the available names may not match the one on the label of your PC.

To identify your computer name pls check the Device Name in the company portal application or open a cmd command window and write hostname.

If your PC is not in the list, please ensure to select Not in the list (PC) and place the name of your computer in the Other Computer Name field, in that case, ensure to fill that field.
- Computer Name: GFT-kK4yU3oNQrT (PC)
- Other Computer name:
- Computer System: Windows
- Additional information:
Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for harming the integrity of your working device, GFT & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, as changing system settings, installing system-level software or stealing confidential information, like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested, if you need it for regular repeating tasks for daily business (please provide reason in ticket request, it will not approved without proper justification).
Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Some clients' requirements demand us not to work with local admin rights, it is highly important that you check prior with your manager that you do not violate client contract by your request.
- List clients and projects you work on.:
Client: XYZ Bank
Project: PEF - Adeguamenti Nuova PEF (KE043026)

- Justification, including the list of software/actions that require you to have admin Rights:
Project Activities
- Important Information:
The provided local admin rights will require to be renewed after 12 Months after the approval. A new request will be required at that time if those rights are still needed.
- GFT Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base GFT Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the GFT Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from GFT Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GFT Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GFT Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GFT Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base GFT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by the GFT/IT Infrastructure Department with the exception of trial software that

query_title: European onboarding
reference_reply:
Below you will find the additional form information for that request and the information you filled out.

- Need: Extra information needed to invite people outside of our Organization for collaboration
- Approval instructions:
For approval, please provide the full name of your GFT employee manager (L5 or above). If they are unavailable, please provide an alternative contact to complete this request.

NOTE: If you are L5 or above, you don't need a manager's approval. Therefore please add your own name as the approver.

The field below only accepts persons with Level L5 or above
- Approver full name: Carlo Rossi (Milan) (XPHJ)
- Guest E-Mail address: lara.santamaria@example.com pedro.velasco@example.com manuel.ramos@example.com dimitris.kouvaris@unipi.gr maria.katsarou@unipi.gr. nuno.garcia@immersivelives.pt
- In which Team the Guest needs to be invited? (GST - XXXXX - XXXXX):
- Permissions level information:
Important:
There are two different permission levels for Guests accessing GFT´s cloud-based infrastructure with O365 and MS-Teams.

By default:
Guests are allowed to use their installed applications (like Word/Excel/PowerPoint/OneDrive/MS-Teams etc.) with the ability to work on GFT documents outside our GFT environment and also save content on non-GFT systems.

Restricted access:
Guests are only allowed to access GFT services and content within a Browser session on office.com. The download of any content and working with installed applications is not allowed. If you want to choose this restricted access, choose it from the below field.
- Permissions level: Default = App & Content download
- Guest Team Important Information:
If you have no Guest Team you need to request one before you can invite Guests to GFT´s Modern Workplace environment on following link.
short.link

Please be aware that new guest accounts which did not accept the invite to a GFT Guest Team in a period of 28 days will be deleted from the GFT’s infrastructure.
Please inform your potential new guest about this period. A new service request will be required again to invite such guests.

   - dimitris.kouvaris@unipi.gr
   - maria.katsarou@unipi.gr

reference_reply:
Below you will find the additional form information for that request and the information you filled out.

- Need: Extra information needed to request admin rights on the computer
- Do you need admin rights for one-time action / software installation?: Yes (Please do not use this subcategory if you need to install Software just one time. Use the Service and Subcategory Windows Software Installation - I need software or a license installed on my computer) do not open this ticket
- Do you need temporary short or long term admin rights?: Short Term: Choose this if Group IT cannot perform the task for you (Please do not open this ticket if you need to install software just one time. Use the Service and Subcategory Windows Software Installation - I need software or a license installed on my computer)
- General Instructions:
Please provide the full name of your XYZ employee manager (L6 or above). If they are unavailable, please provide an alternative contact to complete this request.

NOTE: If you are L6 and above, you don't need a manager approval. Therefore please add your own name as the approver.

The field below only accept persons with Level L6 and above
- Project Manager Full name: Marco Polano (Milano) (GEAL)
- Computer name information:
Below you will find the computers Group IT has already assigned to you, the available names may not match the one on the label of your PC.

To identify your computer name pls check the Device Name in the company portal application or open a cmd command window and write hostname.

If your PC is not in the list, please ensure to select Not in the list (PC) and place the name of your computer in the Other Computer Name field, in that case, ensure to fill that field.
- Computer Name: XYZ-QaYzNCygZbK (PC)
- Other Computer name:
- Computer System: Windows
- Additional information:
Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harming integrity of your working device, XYZ & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, as changing system settings, installing system-level software or steal confidential information, like passwords.

query_title: I need to update my local repository
reference_reply:
Hi Roberto,

Github is not an application supported by Group IT, therefore there is no much we can do.

If you think it's a network issue and you are missing some connection please open a network ticket, but if you can see it on the browser then I think network should be ok.

Just as a hint, are you sure that the url is correct?

I had a quick look and I can see https://github.com/xyz-corp on the browser, but https://github.com/xyz-corp/xyz-project-app.git gives me a 404 error. And in https://github.com/xyz-corp I can only see 2 repos and none of them are xyz-project-app. Of course this can be because I'm not sign in or I'm not looking at the right place.

Regards,

baseline.answer:
Subject: Re: I need to update my local repository

Hi,

Thank you for reaching out regarding the issue with updating your local repository. Based on the error message you provided, it seems there may be a problem with the repository URL or your access permissions.

Here are a few steps you can take to troubleshoot the issue:

1. **Verify Repository URL**: Double-check the URL you are using to ensure it is correct. You can do this by visiting the repository directly in your web browser.

2. **Access Permissions**: Ensure that you have the necessary permissions to access the repository. If you are unsure, please contact your project manager or the repository owner.

3. **Use SSH Instead of HTTPS**: If you are using HTTPS, consider switching to SSH for accessing the repository. This can sometimes resolve access issues.

4. **VPN Connection**: Since you mentioned trying with and without the GFT VPN, ensure that you are connected to the VPN when attempting to access the repository, as it may be required for access.

If the issue persists after trying these steps, please provide any additional error messages or details, and we can further assist you.

Best regards,  
[Your Name]  
IT Support Team

Please provide the full name of your LTA employee manager (L6 or above). If they are unavailable, please provide an alternative contact to complete this request.

NOTE: If you are L6 and above, you don't need a manager approval. Therefore please add your own name as the approver.

The field below only accept persons with Level L6 and above
- Project Manager Full name: Giorgio Salvatore Rinaldi (Rome) (B78Z)
- Computer name information:
Below you will find the computers Group IT has already assigned to you, the available names may not match the one on the label of your PC.

To identify your computer name pls check the Device Name in the company portal application or open a cmd command window and write hostname.

If your PC is not in the list, please ensure to select Not in the list (PC) and place the name of your computer in the Other Computer Name field, in that case, ensure to fill that field.
- Computer Name: LTA-bxA45PQRUJw (PC)
- Other Computer name:
- Computer System: Windows
- Additional information:
Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harming integrity of your working device, LTA & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, as changing system settings, installing system-level software or steal confidential information, like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested, if you need it for regular repeating tasks for daily business (please provide reason in ticket request, it will not approved without proper justification).
Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Some clients requirements demands us to not work with local admin rights, it is highly important that you check prior with your manager that you do not violate client contract by your request.
- List clients and projects you work on.:
NextGen (BankSystemX)
- Justification, including the list of software/actions that requires you to have admin Rights:
Intellij updates
Envirnonment varables
- Important Information:
The provided local admin rights will require to be renewed after 12 Months after the approval. A new request will be required at that time if those rigths are still needed.
- LTA Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base LTA Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the LTA Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from LTA Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of LTA Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between LTA Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a LTA Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base LTA Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e. viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by the LTA/IT Infrastructure Department with the exception of trial software that should only be used for evaluation purposes

- You are also responsible for providing a patch management process for the software that you additionally

query_title: Request for Administrator Privileges on GFT Work Computer
reference_reply:
Below you will find the additional form information for that request and the information you filled out.

- Need: Extra information needed to request admin rights on the computer
- Do you need admin rights for one-time action / software installation?: No I need those rights every week for running and installing software.
- Do you need temporary short or long term admin rights?: Long Term: Choose this if you need to regularly execute administrative tasks (justification required)
- General Instructions:
Please provide the full name of your GFT employee manager (L6 or above). If they are unavailable, please provide an alternative contact to complete this request.

NOTE: If you are L6 and above, you don't need a manager approval. Therefore please add your own name as the approver.

The field below only accept persons with Level L6 and above
- Project Manager Full name: Jane Smith (Milano) (B45G)
- Computer name information:
Below you will find the computers Group IT has already assigned to you, the available names may not match the one on the label of your PC.

To identify your computer name pls check the Device Name in the company portal application or open a cmd command window and write hostname.

If your PC is not in the list, please ensure to select Not in the list (PC) and place the name of your computer in the Other Computer Name field, in that case, ensure to fill that field.
- Computer Name: GFT-AbCdEf12345 (PC)
- Other Computer name:
- Computer System: Windows
- Additional information:
Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harming integrity of your working device, GFT & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, as changing system settings, installing system-level software or steal confidential information, like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested, if you need it for regular repeating tasks for daily business (please provide reason in ticket request, it will not approved without proper justification).
Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Some clients requirements demands us to not work with local admin rights, it is highly important that you check prior with your manager that you do not violate client contract by your request.
- List clients and projects you work on.:
IBEF Max Mara
- Justification, including the list of software/actions that requires you to have admin Rights:
As part of my day-to-day duties, I am frequently required to modify system variables and the host file on my workstation.
- Important Information:
The provided local admin rights will require to be renewed after 12 Months after the approval. A new request will be required at that time if those rights are still needed.
- GFT Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base GFT Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the GFT Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from GFT Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GFT Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GFT Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GFT Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base GFT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages

✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base GFT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
